name: reel-perro-pinata
description: Edición viral (Facebook Reel) del video del perro y la piñata

scripts.render: remotion render ReelPerroPinata out/reel-perro-pinata.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 && npm run exportar
scripts.exportar: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/reel-perro-pinata.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 20 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -maxrate 12M -bufsize 24M -movflags +faststart -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 out/reel-perro-pinata-facebook.mp4
